text:
maria: Hey team — kicking off a small pilot to automate quarterly access recertification for admin entitlements. goal: flag stale admins, surface ownerless KMS keys, and provide a one-click revoke/confirm flow for app owners. thoughts?
jonathan: Love it. What's the exact scope for the pilot? org units, roles, or specific projects? :eyes:
maria: Start with all IAM principals in org:roles that map to admin-level policies (Admin, Owner, CloudKMSAdmin). limit to 3 projects: infra-prod, infra-staging, sandbox-ops. keep everything read-only for the first run.
sec-bot: Automated scan completed for infra-staging: 18 admin principals, 4 ownerless KMS keys, 2 svcacct keys older than 180 days. See quick summary: https://internal.redwood/sec/recert/reports/1972101111
alex: Quick Q: how are we defining "ownerless" for KMS? key has no iam binding to a user? or no delegate contact in our ownership table?
maria: We'll treat ownerless if there's no human principal in the key's metadata + no entry in ownership registry. svcacct-to-human mapping will be another pass.
jonathan: For the pilot we should require an action window and a safe rollback path. Proposed flow: export candidate list -> notify owners -> owners must confirm or request extension within 7 days -> if no response, throttle/remove admin bindings in canary projects only.
tara: Rollback path: record a reversible change via a change ticket and store the exported policy blob in encrypted storage. also need Slack notifications and a post-action audit entry. :white_check_mark:
maria: For encryption I'm proposing we use our KMS keyring: gcloud kms encrypt --location global --keyring recert-pilot --key audit-pack --plaintext-file candidates.json --ciphertext-file candidates.json.enc
jonathan: Nice. Also need to ensure audit logs link back to the exact policy change; include the admin_token and change_id in the log entry. Example audit metadata: change_id=recert-1972101111; operator=automation
sec-bot: Note: current audit-log retention for project infra-prod is 90 days. Any change to retention needs SOC approval.
alex: We also need a query to pull last_authn time so we can exclude recently active admins. For BigQuery logs we can use: ```SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS principal, MAX(timestamp) as last_auth FROM `redwood-logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com.activity_*` WHERE protoPayload.methodName LIKE '%login%' GROUP BY principal```
jonathan: Nice query. Add a join on our entitlement table to map role -> severity. We should weigh inactive but high-severity roles differently.
maria: Edge cases: service accounts used by long-running jobs will show low last_authn but still required. Proposal: if svcacct used by a scheduler or has an owner in infra team tag, auto-exempt but send a verification link to the tagged owner.
tara: Escalation: if owner doesn't respond in 7 days, page on-call infra-sre, and lock admin role in sandbox and staging first, prod only after 30 days.
johnathan: (typo correction) jonathan: we should also include a dry-run mode that emits planned IAM delta without applying.
maria: Agreed. Pilot timeline: week 0: scan + dry-run -> week 1: owner notifications -> week 2: canary revocations in staging -> week 4: evaluate results and tweak rules.
sec-bot: Action items recorded: recert-1972101111:create-scan, recert-1972101111:dry-run, recert-1972101111:notify-owners
alex: I'll draft the dry-run script. putting a draft here in the thread in a sec.
maria: Thanks — can each of you add any blocking compliance or SOC asks inline? want to have the checklist before we run dry-run.
jonathan: Blocking: SOC signoff if we modify log retention; need a runbook for human error reversal; add canary guardrails with automatic fallback to previous policy on error.
tara: Blocking: ensure the recert toolset writes immutable evidence to our WORM bucket; include signed JSON blobs.
alex: Drafted dry-run command snippet: ```python recert.py --projects infra-prod,infra-staging,sandbox-ops --mode dry-run --out candidates.json.enc --kms-key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/recert/cryptoKeys/audit-pack```
maria: Perfect. I'll coordinate SOC approval and book a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk the runbook. thanks all. :shipit:
